messages:
Maya: Heads-up, PR #3782 adds a compact "Embedding & Cache" quickstart to Optimize Toolkit. Short checklist: snippets (py/js), cache-key guidance, and a tiny quant table. Need eyeballs.
Rafael: I'll review the quant table. Quick ask: do we want to recommend any default quant profile for embedding-heavy search apps?
Ivy: From docs POV, we should keep the text very prescriptive: 1-2 bullets max. Suggest: q4_0 for cost-sensitive small-batch jobs, q8_0 for higher fidelity. Add a one-line caveat about short-text degradation.
Ben: SDK detail: our JS v1.5+ uses `client.embeddings.generate()`; earlier examples used `create()` which confuses people. Include both or clearly label by language/version.
Maya: I'll split the snippets and add version notes. Current python snippet in PR:
```python
# python (non-streaming)
resp = client.embeddings.create(model="redwood-embed-1", input=["a","b"]) 
# cache key suggestion: sha256(model + user_bucket + first_96_chars(input))
```
Rafael: For the quant table I'll attach a CSV with P@10 deltas and overall latency numbers. Will reference it as a footnote not inline.
Ivy: DocsBot flagged the PR: missing anchor id for "cache key" and a broken link to Optimize Toolkit glossary. DocsBot: docs/lint/link-check failed.
DocsBot: PR #3782 lint result: anchors.missing -> add "#cache-key" anchor, links.broken -> docs/opt/glossary -> 404.
Ben: I'll send a tiny follow-up to update the glossary path. Also, add a one-liner in the snippet that says "embeddings are not streamed" to reduce confusion.
Maya: Good. Also adding a micro-example showing prefix vs KV: 2 lines max.
Ivy: Suggest wording: "Use prefix cache for repeated system instructions; use KV cache for long sessions with evolving state." Short and concrete.
Rafael: On the ML side, reminder: for batches > 16 we saw q8_0 give better stability. I'll note batch-size guidance in the table.
Ben: I'm going to patch the JS snippet to show v1.4 compatibility and v1.5+ variant. Example for JS v1.5+:
```javascript
// js v1.5+
const r = await client.embeddings.generate({ model: 'redwood-embed-1', input })
```
Ivy: Anything else? We should include a short migration note for teams that used older cache keys with timestamps. Recommend removing volatile fields and rotating keys intentionally.
Maya: Done. Timeline: Ivy will push the copy + anchor fix in ~30m, Rafael uploads the CSV, Ben updates JS snippet. I'll run the lint and merge once green. Target: merge before tomorrow's docs deploy. @Ivy @Rafael @Ben any blockers?
Ivy: No blockers, will PR edits now. :white_check_mark:
Rafael: On it, uploading data in 20m.
Ben: Will send the JS follow-up shortly.
Maya: Thanks team. I'll monitor for any post-merge link fallout. :rocket:
